query:
SELECT count(*) AS "total!",count(*) FILTER(WHERE s.origin=target.origin) AS "origin!",
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.actor_uri=$2 AND e.state='active') AS "author!" FROM discovery_entries e JOIN discovery_sources s ON s.id=e.source_id
        CROSS JOIN discovery_sources target WHERE target.id=$1 AND e.kind='post'
